useCase: Detección de texto generado por IAures, dominio de frecuencia manipulación, and model-specific artefactos
mechanism: Aplica multi-level DWT decomposition and analiza estadístico properties of detail coeficientes (LH, HL, HH sub-bands). generado por IA images exhibit different energy distribucións and coeficiente correlacións in wavelet domain.
accuracy: Alta - 85-92% for detecting GAN and diffusion model outputs
name: Análisis Wavelet
parameters: Wavelet: Daubechies-4, Levels: 3-5, Sub-bands: LH/HL/HH, Metrics: energy, varianza, kurtosis per sub-band
description: Decomposes the image using wavelet transforms to analyze frequency sub-bands. AI models leave characteristic patrones in high-frequency wavelet coeficientes.

references.title: Li, H. et al. (2018). Can Forensic Detectors Identify GAN Generated Images? APSIPA ASC.
Mallat, S. (1989). A Theory for Multiresolution Signal Decomposition. IEEE TPAMI.

strengths:
• Multi-scale frequency análisis
• High precisión for GAN and diffusion models
• Captures energy distribución anomalías
• Well-established signal processing technique
limitations:
• Requires sufficient image resolución
• Heavy compresión JPEG affects wavelet coeficientes
• Computational cost increases with decomposition levels
• Performance varies a través de different AI architectures
